answer: One concrete Sybil defense is proof-of-human-work. Each new identity must repeatedly solve a unique task that only real human perception handles, like spotting the odd image among many. A clone farm cannot script these at scale; the zephyr of cheap automated attempts fails the mechanization filters. The comet of expense climbs with every fake account because each demands scarce human attention to earn trust at the network summit. Reused solvers get flagged and slashed.
